items.title: a QUALIFIED call to a blanket impl's member is not monomorphized: `impl type T: PartialEq with Same { fun same(&self, other: &T) }; Same::same(a, &b)` prints `false` on JS (an un-instanced `self === other` over two pairs); natively "a value of an unbound generic type parameter"; `a.same(&b)` is right
items.body: Rec: route `Trait::member(x, ..)` through the same instance selection as the method call. B473 fixed the qualified call's trait; this is its instance. Sizing M; solver, Order 46 FIRST.

items.title: an unannotated `let x = if c { &a } else { &b }` is not seen as a view binding (`view_binding_mutability` does not look through branches): it binds the aggregate itself
items.body: B496's family. Reproduce first. Rec: a value `if`/`match` whose leaves are views is a view initializer, or refuse with B496's sentence. Sizing S.

items.title: native: a `mut` PATTERN binder is emitted without `mut`: `match Some(1) { Some(mut p) => bump(&mut p) }` and `mut (c, d) = (3, 4); bump(&mut c)` → rustc E0596
items.body: store.vl's through-variant write keeps a rebind for it. Rec: emit `mut` on mutable pattern binders. Sizing S.

items.title: native: a `for e in &mut xs` element handed on inside a generic body is emitted `&mut e` instead of a reborrow `&mut *e` (E0596): `fun each<T>(xs: &mut List<T>, f: \|&mut T\| void) { for e in &mut xs { f(e) } }`
items.body: Rec: reborrow, as `call_arguments` does for loans. Sizing S.
